definitions: A synthetic peptide that acts as a dual glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide (GIP) and glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonist.
A medication used for the treatment of type 2 diabetes and for weight management.
examples: Tirzepatide has shown significant efficacy in clinical trials.
Patients taking tirzepatide experienced notable weight loss.
The doctor prescribed tirzepatide for her diabetes.
